description: This PHP source file defines the class 'OAuth2AuthCodes', which manages OAuth2 authorization codes within the SuiteCRM project. It includes properties for database interactions, security, and authorization logic, as well as methods for checking if a code is revoked, scope authorization, and query customization.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthCodes
classes.description: A class representing OAuth2 authorization codes, including properties and methods to manage OAuth2 authorization code lifecycle, security status, and querying within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: is_revoked
methods.description: Checks whether the authorization code has been revoked or expired.

methods.name: is_scope_authorized
methods.description: Determines if the scope requested by an authorization request is authorized for this code.
